_note: Register fragment for harvest-feed-intake (REQ-HFI-005, ADR-037). A publication harvested from a DCAT feed names its source: `source` is the harvested dataset's @id (written as dct:source in the outbound DCAT feed) and `derivedFrom` is the uuid of the OpenRegister source that harvested it (prov:wasDerivedFrom). OpenRegister writes both after mapping, from each feed's `provenance` setting, so a mapping cannot override them. The version bump for these properties is carried by woo-x-access-boundary-hardening.json, which sorts last and wins the scalar merge.

source.title: Source
source.description: The dataset this publication was harvested from, as its @id in the source catalogue.

derivedFrom.title: Harvested from
derivedFrom.description: The harvest feed that brought this publication in, as its OpenRegister source uuid.
